programme.title: Weekendowa metamorfoza 3
programme.desc: Kajtek to trzynastoletni miłośnik gier komputerowych i rowerów, który uważa się już za nastolatka. Nie podoba mu się jego obecny pokój. Wydaje mu się bardzo dziecinny. Marzy o sypialni, którą będzie mógł pochwalić się swoim kolegom. Rodzice chłopca postanawiają więc z pomocą Krzysztofa Mirucia spełnić jego życzenie. Wspólnie knują intrygę, chcąc wyremontować pomieszczenie zaledwie w trzy dni. Po metamorfozie słynnego architekta chłopięcy pokój zamieni się w minimalistyczną przestrzeń w japońskim stylu.

programme.title: Tendas Modernas - T02E02

programme.title: Tropic Like It's Hot T1 - Ep. 10

programme.title: Weekendowa metamorfoza 3
programme.desc: Ania i Marek są razem od pięciu lat, a trzy i pół roku temu postanowili razem zamieszkać. Połączyła ich wspólna pasja do gier fabularnych i miłość do zwierząt. Mężczyzna udziela się w schronisku jako wolontariusz. Razem z partnerką przygarnęli suczkę oraz kota. Niedaleko mieszka przyjaciółka pary, Magda, która sama była uczestniczką jednego z odcinków "Weekendowej metamorfozy", kiedy remontowano jej salon. Teraz Ania za każdym razem się nim zachwyca, zazdrości i przyznaje, że sama chciałaby otrzymać taką niespodziankę. Marek spełnił marzenie ukochanej, wysłał zgłoszenie do programu. Krzysztof Miruć ma za zadanie zmienić ich salon, któremu należy dodać funkcjonalności. Ania pragnie, żeby w pomieszczeniu zapanował styl scandi boho, czyli jasne kolory oraz skandynawski minimalizm połączony z naturalnymi elementami, takimi jak drewno czy kwiaty.

programme.desc: Iza i jej narzeczony Kamil mieszkają w Białymstoku. Iza, z zamiłowania florystka, prowadzi kwiaciarnię, a Kamil zajmuje się remontami oraz wykańczaniem wnętrz. Kobieta ma dwie córki, starsza 21-letnia mieszka w Wielkiej Brytanii, młodsza Ola ma 11 lat. Para poznała się rok temu i niedawno się zaręczyła. Kamil dla swojej ukochanej kompletnie zmienił plany życiowe i po kilku latach spędzonych w Belgii wrócił do Polski. Zakochani za pół roku biorą ślub i postanowili kupić nieruchomość, w której urządzą swoje rodzinne gniazdko. Oczekiwania mają rozbieżne, ponieważ Kamil marzy o domu poza miastem, Iza natomiast uważa, że na tym etapie ich życia najlepsze będzie dla nich mieszkanie w mieście. Kobiecie marzy się trzypokojowa nieruchomość z zamkniętą kuchnią oraz dużym salonem. Para jest jednak zgodna co do tego, że w łazience powinna być wanna. Agent postara się znaleźć nieruchomość, która przypadnie do gustu zarówno Izie, jak i jej narzeczonemu.

W każdym odcinku projektantka odwiedzi właścicieli mieszkania i przeprowadzi metamorfozę wybranego przez nich pokoju. Sukces pomoże też osiągnąć wprowadzenie sprytnych usprawnień, mądry wybór materiałów i dodatków, zmiana kolorystyki oraz aranżacji. programme.title: O anchetă complicată
programme.desc: Rosario, anii ’80. Un bărbat dispare în timpul dictaturii militare. Doi tineri trebuie să facă tot posibilul pentru a rezolva cazul, asta deși polițiștii corupți le pun viața în pericol.

programme.title: Vizitatorii
programme.desc: In anul 1122, prin actiunea concertata a unei vrajitoare sinistre si a unui magician glumet, razboinicul de vita veche Godefroy de Montmirail si scutierul sau Jacquouille la Fripouille sunt trimisi in viitor, intr-o epoca nebuna, in zilele noastre.

programme.title: Vremuri întunecate
programme.desc: Cinci tineri nord-americani sosesc în capitala Rusiei pentru a petrece o vacanţă de vis într-o metropolă despre care nu cunosc prea multe amănunte, dar se trezesc blocaţi într-un oraş invadat de o specie extraterestră malefică.

programme.title: Căzut din cer
programme.desc: Ajunsă in Savannah după ce prietenul ei moare într-un accident misterios, Lucinda, o adolescentă de 17 ani, se îndrăgostește de Daniel, dar descoperă un adevăr incredibil de tulburător: el este un înger căzut, iar iubirea lor este veche de secole...

programme.title: Eroul
programme.desc: In China antica impartita in 7 regate, luptatori din 6 regate vor sa il asasineze pe cel mai puternic conducator: Qin. Cand un dregator lipsit de importanta infrange 3 mari dusmani ai lui Qin, este chemat la palat sa-si spuna povestea.

programme.title: În bătaia puștii
programme.desc: Frank Horrigan este un agent al serviciilor secrete, dur și inflexibil, obsedat de o greșeală din trecutul său. Nu poate uita data de 22 noiembrie 1963, când nu l-a putut apăra pe președintele John F. Kennedy, în timpul fatalei vizite din Dallas.

programme.title: Călugărul coboară de pe munte
programme.desc: Bazat pe romanul lui Xu Haofeng "Un călugăr vine pe munte", filmul relatează povestea unui tânăr cleric taoist numit He Anxia, care in anii 1930 este expulzat din mănăstire și ajunge într-un oraș chinezesc.

programme.title: Terminatorul 3: Supremația roboților
programme.desc: John are acum 18 ani, iar o femeie Terminator, Terminatrix, este trimisă de către roboţi pe urmele sale pentru a-l asasina. Alt Terminator se va întoarce în trecut pentru a-l proteja pe John: T-800 se întoarce şi va lupta în războiul contra roboţilor.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volumul 2
programme.desc: Mireasa îşi continuă răzbunarea cu următorii de pe listă, lăsându-l la final pe Bill. Dar şi Bill îi pregăteşte o surpriză de proporţii. Capitolul final al celui mai îndrăzneţ proiect al lui Quentin Tarantino!

programme.title: Revolta robotilor
programme.desc: Un producător american de arme își testează cei 4 roboți ucigași pe producătorii de heroină din Triunghiul de Aur, în Asia de Sud-Est. Lucrurile scapa de sub control.

programme.title: Deep Star 6
programme.desc: O echipă de membri ai marinei staționate la o bază temporară pe fundul oceanului și însărcinate cu instalarea rachetelor nucleare descoperă o imensă cavernă subacvatică ce adăpostește o creatură preistorică uriașă.

programme.title: Zile de groază
programme.desc: Uraganele se abat asupra golfului. Furtuni naprasnice aprind cerul. Pentru Amy, venită din Chicago in cautarea unui nou inceput, teama de aceasta manifestare a naturii se impleteste cu groaza că intreaga populatie ar putea rămâne pe intuneric.

programme.title: Zile de groază
programme.desc: Uraganele se abat asupra golfului. Furtuni naprasnice aprind cerul. Pentru Amy, venită din Chicago in cautarea unui nou inceput, teama de aceasta manifestare a naturii se impleteste cu groaza că intreaga populatie ar putea rămâne pe intuneric.

programme.title: Cu foamea-n gât
programme.desc: Europa evului mediu le ofera lui Hector Fieramosca (Bud Spencer) si soldatilor sai suficiente ocazii de a castiga bani. Fiind mercenari, pentru a-si primi onorariul, acestia ar trebui sa se alature taberei care are sorti sa castige batalia.

programme.title: Henric al VIII-lea
programme.desc: Tiran si afemeiat, Henry VIII a fost regele care a schimbat Anglia pentru totdeauna. De peste 450 de ani, cati au trecut de la moartea sa, viata si mostenirea lui Henry VIII continua sa fascineze o lume intreaga.

programme.title: Henric al VIII-lea
programme.desc: Tiran si afemeiat, Henry VIII a fost regele care a schimbat Anglia pentru totdeauna. De peste 450 de ani, cati au trecut de la moartea sa, viata si mostenirea lui Henry VIII continua sa fascineze o lume intreaga.

programme.title: Piedone la Hong Kong
programme.desc: Comisarului Rizzo, in achetarea unui caz ce i-a fost repartizat, i se insceneaza mai multe infractiuni. Cum si in cadrul politiei exista persoane implicate in savarsirea unor faradelegi, el este nevoit sa plece pe firul evenimentelor.

programme.title: Dragonul de aur
programme.desc: Superstarul filmelor de actiune, Jean Claude Van Damme isi face debutul regizoral cu Dragonul de aur, un film exploziv in care Van Damme interpreteaza rolul unui infractor marunt pe nume Chris Dubois, a carui existenta va fi mult incercata.

programme.title: Cavalerul de oțel
programme.desc: Filmul prezinta un grup de cavalieri templieri care apără castelul Rochester de regele John (Paul Giamatti), care este, pare-se, un mare ticălos.

programme.title: Pe muchia dreptății
programme.desc: În Los Angeles, Agentul Maxwell descoperă o operațiune de contrabandă de cocaină internațională condusă de Vincent Camastra. Când Beverly Royce merge sub acoperire și ia legătura cu dealerii de droguri, se afundă mai adânc decât sperase.

programme.title: Râuri de purpură 2: Îngerii apocalipsei
programme.desc: Continuare a filmului de succes Râuri de purpură, regizat de Mathieu Kassovitz. În Lorena, lângă graniţa cu Germania, Inspectorul-Sef Pierre\nNiemans (Jean Reno) anchetează moartea unui om care a fost crucificat,\nîntr-un ritual.

programme.title: Cu foamea-n gât
programme.desc: Europa evului mediu le ofera lui Hector Fieramosca (Bud Spencer) si soldatilor sai suficiente ocazii de a castiga bani. Fiind mercenari, pentru a-si primi onorariul, acestia ar trebui sa se alature taberei care are sorti sa castige batalia.

programme.title: Vizitatorii 2: Culoarele timpului
programme.desc: Pelicula continua aventurile cavalerului Godefroy de Montmirail care acum se pregateste de nunta cu Frenegonde de Pouille. Numai ca tatal ei intrerupe pregatirile pe motiv ca i se furasera bijuteriile si dantela cuvioasei Sainte-Rolande.

programme.title: Eroul
programme.desc: In China antica impartita in 7 regate, luptatori din 6 regate vor sa il asasineze pe cel mai puternic conducator: Qin. Cand un dregator lipsit de importanta infrange 3 mari dusmani ai lui Qin, este chemat la palat sa-si spuna povestea.

programme.title: În bătaia puștii
programme.desc: Frank Horrigan este un agent al serviciilor secrete, dur și inflexibil, obsedat de o greșeală din trecutul său. Nu poate uita data de 22 noiembrie 1963, când nu l-a putut apăra pe președintele John F. Kennedy, în timpul fatalei vizite din Dallas.

programme.title: Călugărul coboară de pe munte
programme.desc: Bazat pe romanul lui Xu Haofeng "Un călugăr vine pe munte", filmul relatează povestea unui tânăr cleric taoist numit He Anxia, care in anii 1930 este expulzat din mănăstire și ajunge într-un oraș chinezesc.

programme.title: Detectiv fără voie
programme.desc: Hoțul de bijuterii Miles Logan vrea să recupereze un diamant pe care-l furase printr-o acțiune spectaculoasă și apoi să dispară pentru o vreme. El pretinde ca ar fi politist si se alege cu reputația de cel mai curajos, dur și nostim ofițer din L.A..

programme.title: District 13: Ultimatum
programme.desc: Districtul 13 este controlat de mai multe grupări care se luptă pentru supremație. Damien și Leito trebuie să readucă pacea în acest sector tulburat, înainte că serviciile secrete ale orașului să ia măsuri drastice pentru a rezolva problema.

programme.title: 30 de zile de noapte
programme.desc: Orăşelul Barrow se află în Alaska şi, în fiecare an, este cufundat în noapte timp de o lună. În timp ce majoritatea locuitorilor se îndreaptă către sud în timpul iernii, un misterios grup de străini apare: vampiri însetaţi de sânge.

programme.title: Garnizoana
programme.desc: Robert, un fost agent CIA și fiul său înstrăinat sunt captivi într-un buncăr high-tech. Vor fi zidurile groase și apărările suficient de puternice împotriva forțelor lui Balzary, un dusman de temut de-ai lui Robert?

programme.title: Impact fatal 2
programme.desc: Kit (Wu Jing) este un ofiţer de poliţie din Hong Kong care lucrează sub acoperire pentru a-l prinde pe dl Hung, capul unei organizaţii criminale. Atunci când operaţiunea eşuează şi poliţiştii sub acoperire sunt trădaţi, Kit dispare fără urmă.

programme.title: Febra de preerie
programme.desc: Când acceptă să transporte trei femei diagonosticate cu „febră de preerie” la staţia de tren din Carson City, Şeriful Preston Briggs porneşte într-o adevărată aventură.

programme.title: Weird Earth
programme.desc: Chase a child carried away by a wave that appeared out of nowhere; feel the shock when a hiker encounters a living, slithering slime ball in the desert; watch a plane's close encounter with a fire-spitting cloud 20,000 feet above the Earth.

programme.title: Abandoned Inventions
programme.desc: Uncovering the fallout from a terrifying nuclear missile program and a failed living weapon; learning how abandoned military experiments created unexpected breakthroughs, from the materials used in modern computers to new ways of sensing the world.

programme.title: Building Giants
programme.desc: Navigate crushing pressure and unstable geology beneath the Alps as crews carve the world's longest railway tunnel; tag along as engineers use 2,300-tonne tunneling machines and explosives to create a 57-kilometer rail link between Lyon and Turin.

programme.title: Weird Earth
programme.desc: Chase a child carried away by a wave that appeared out of nowhere; feel the shock when a hiker encounters a living, slithering slime ball in the desert; watch a plane's close encounter with a fire-spitting cloud 20,000 feet above the Earth.

programme.title: The World's Deadliest Weather
programme.desc: Hurricane Florence causes biblical-level flooding in North Carolina; a magnitude seven earthquake rocks Anchorage, Alaska; a colossal wave swamps a surfer in Nazaré, Portugal.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
programme.desc: A complex built to entomb British spies and a once ingenious military facility; the imprint of ancient culture around a deserted Italian town; the shell of a highly classified Soviet weapons factory hidden in an Estonian forest.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
programme.desc: An unassuming factory marks a revolutionary leap forward - and upward - in how humans travel; due to ongoing legal battles and innovative designs from their many competitors, these historic upstarts would soon be grounded.

programme.title: River Monsters
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade investigates rumors of a twenty-foot lake monster that attacks people; with snakes, freshwater sharks and giant sturgeon unlikely possibilities, the answer as to what it is drives Jeremy crazy.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
programme.desc: A sprawling military facility dotted with bunkers for miles now stands abandoned in the American heartland of Edgemont, S.D.; experts investigate and uncover a once highly-secure WWII ordnance site designed to store deadly munitions.

programme.title: Buried Evidence
programme.desc: Re-evaluating what we know about evolution, extinction, and animals' sacred roles. Dig up a Canadian dinosaur that sparks questions about fossilization, meet a prehistoric survivor in China, and see the religious parts crocodiles played in Egypt.

programme.title: Mysteries From Above
programme.desc: Witness animal spectacles from high above the Earth; watch a whirling herd of northern nomads; see undersea behemoths show off in the Pacific shallows; track a U.S. porcine stampede; confront top ocean predators on the Florida coast.

programme.title: River Monsters
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade fights through tropical storms and dangerous jungles to search for a Fijian killer that has been part of the local folklore for years, but there may be more than one.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: A brain-busting series of questions on the film "Batman vs. Superman;" an art history student strikes out in her chosen category, then bets it all on a food-and-drink challenge that leaves the last contestant hungry for a jackpot win.

Luckily, he finds an unlikely source for guidance - Wild Knuckles himself - and soon discovers that even bad guys need a little help from their friends.

programme.title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey

The journey takes Bilbo on a path through treacherous lands swarming with orcs, goblins and other dangers, not the least of which is an encounter with Gollum and a simple gold ring that is tied to the fate of Middle Earth in ways Bilbo cannot even fathom.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug

More dangers await them, including the skin-changer Beorn and the giant spiders of Mirkwood. After escaping capture by the dangerous Wood Elves, Bilbo and the dwarves journey to Lake-town and, finally, to the Lonely Mountain, where they face the greatest danger of all: the fearsome dragon Smaug.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
programme.desc: Having reclaimed Erebor and vast treasure from the dragon Smaug, Thorin Oakenshield sacrifices friendship and honor in seeking the Arkenstone, despite Smaug's fiery wrath and desperate attempts by the Hobbit Bilbo to make him see reason. Meanwhile, Sauron sends legions of Orcs in a sneak attack upon the Lonely Mountain. As the fate of Middle Earth hangs in the balance, the races of Men, Elves and Dwarves must decide whether to unite and prevail - or all die.

Meanwhile, Terri's singing partner, Jay (Oliver James), is harboring a secret crush.

Convinced that Zac cheated, Frankie demands a rematch and raises the stakes by betting his team's clubhouse. Frankie and the gang build a spectacular new race track and the stage is set for the biggest race of the season.

Learning that they have been betrayed by one of their own, Dominic and his friends conspire to use the book's teachings to turn the tables.

Unfortunately, under the mask's influence, Ipkiss also robs a bank, which angers junior crime lord Dorian Tyrell (Peter Greene), whose goons get blamed for the heist.

They're beautiful, they're brilliant, and they work for Charlie. In "Charlie's Angels," a sexy, high-octane update of the original '70s action-comedy TV series.

After a scandal involving her husband, the church is forced to temporarily close, leaving Trinitie struggling to manage the aftermath. Now, she and her spouse must rebuild their congregation and reconcile their faith by all means necessary to make the biggest comeback that commodified religion has ever seen.

When Brennan's mother and Dale's father marry and move in together, it turns the overgrown boys' world upside down. Aiding in the investigation is Harry's former Pokémon partner, super-sleuth Detective Pikachu. Finding that they are uniquely equipped to work together, as Tim is the only human who can talk with Pikachu, they join forces to unravel the tangled mystery.

Soon after learning that his museum friends have been shipped to the Smithsonian Institution, Larry receives a distress call from Jedediah, who warns him that four of history's greatest villains have come to life and are planning to take over the Smithsonian first, then the world. Larry joins forces with friends old and new to stop the quartet's nefarious plans.

He learns that the Tablet, which magically brings Teddy Roosevelt (Robin Williams), Jedediah (Owen Wilson) and the other exhibits to life at night, has started to decay. Larry, along with his son and museum friends, must travel to London's British Museum to learn how to prevent the Tablet's magic from disappearing.

A devotee of the dark arts, Blackwood has a bigger scheme in mind, and his execution plays right into his plans. The game is afoot when Blackwood seems to rise from the grave, plunging Holmes and Watson into the world of the occult and strange technologies.

However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition.

But, as voracious consumers of sensational tabloids, his parents soon come to suspect that Harriet is actually a notorious serial killer - "Mrs. X" - wanted in connection with a string of bizarre honeymoon killings. Danielle's stepmother Rodmilla is a heartless woman who forces Danielle to do the cooking and cleaning, while she tries to marry off her own two daughters. But Danielle's life takes a wonderful turn when she meets the charming Prince Henry.

Bringing the extraterrestrial into his suburban California house, Elliott introduces E.T., as the alien is dubbed, to his brother and his little sister, Gertie, and the children decide to keep its existence a secret. Soon, however, E.T. falls ill, resulting in government intervention and a dire situation for both Elliott and the alien.

Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem - a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2

Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

The war appears to tip in favor of the Decepticons, leading to a climactic battle in Chicago.

programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie

Leaving the familiar confines of Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob and Patrick venture out towards Shell City, where they hope to find Neptune's crown, but numerous obstacles stand (or float) in their way.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends

With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

programme.title: Supergirl

With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

programme.title: Go Further
programme.desc: In this documentary, actor and environmental activist Woody Harrelson joins an eclectic group, including a raw food chef, a hemp activist, a yoga teacher and iconic '60s author Ken Kesey as they travel down the Pacific Coast Highway in a bio-fueled bus. programme.title: Metal: A Headbanger's Journey
programme.desc: Filmmaker and anthropologist Sam Dunn investigates the origins and subculture surrounding heavy metal, tracing the genre's roots from 1970s post-industrial England to its 1980s pop crossover to its modern-day variants in Norwegian black metal. Told from the perspective of a devoted fan, Dunn balances his insider's view with interviews with some of metal's most influential artists -- including Alice Cooper, Bruce Dickinson and Rob Zombie -- as well as enthusiastic acolytes.

programme.title: Live: Good Morning Football
programme.desc: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.

programme.title: Live: Good Morning Football
programme.desc: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Quick Pitch
programme.desc: Sometimes, fans of America's national pastime might miss a day or two of their favorite sport due to pesky things like work, a wedding anniversary, or a child's high-school graduation ceremony. Rest easy, devotees of the diamond -- MLB Network has you covered. "Quick Pitch" not only provides complete highlights of each game from the previous day, but also presents a glimpse at upcoming contests, including pitching matchups.

programme.title: Play Ball
programme.desc: Major League Baseball's initiative to promote the game to a younger generation includes "Play Ball," a half-hour series that features some of the game's top players. The players discuss their own experiences in youth baseball and various ways in which they enjoyed the game while growing up. The show also provides tips on how kids can participate in all forms of baseball activities, plus highlights on and off the field throughout MLB.

programme.title: MLB Network Breakdown
programme.desc: The best breakdowns and demos by MLB Network Analysts will be showcased including segments from the 9,600-square foot Studio 42 and on-screen virtual enhancements that are integral to MLB Network's comprehensive coverage of the game.

programme.title: Plays of the Week
programme.desc: Too bad this baseball show wasn't around back on May 26, 1993 -- the fly ball that bounced off Texas Rangers outfielder Jose Canseco's head and flew over the fence for a home run would have certainly made the cut. Not all highlights can be that entertaining, but this series collects equally amazing examples of big hits and fielding gems from the previous week.

programme.title: Live: MLB Tonight
programme.desc: When they're not tuning in to the games themselves, baseball fans know where to turn for their nightly baseball fix. MLB Network's signature program, "MLB Tonight" presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast.
